kubejs.dialogue.sprite.start: Hey! Now that you've prototyped me, I can finally talk to you properly!
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.start.land: Welcome to your Land! Don't worry, I'll stay close to the house.
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.start.desc: Your sprite bobs in the air in front of you, waiting for you to say something.
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.what_are_you: I'm your Sprite! I'm part kernel and part whatever you prototyped me with. I'll float around here and help however I can.
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.what_are_you.desc: It does a little spin, clearly proud of itself.
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.what_now: Get into the Medium before the meteor hits! Carve a cruxite dowel on the Totem Lathe, alchemize your artifact and use it.
kubejs.dialogue.sprite.what_now.desc: It floats over towards the Cruxtruder, then looks back at you.
